hooks.command: [ -d "$HOME/notes/personal" ] || exit 0; printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"The plan was just approved. Offer to save it to the Obsidian vault: apply the obsidian-project sizing rule first (trivial work warrants no note), then suggest /to-workstream and /to-tasks, or a single task note. A plan never becomes a separate plan note.\"}}"

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // \"\""); case "$f" in */memory/*) [ "${f##*/}" = "MEMORY.md" ] || printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"About to write auto-memory. Decide where this belongs before writing. Anything that should hold on every machine - working preferences, conventions, workflow rules - belongs in ~/dev/nix-config/home/agent (deployed to ~/.config/agent by Home Manager): AGENTS.md for general preferences, CODING_STANDARDS.md for code conventions, an existing skill when it qualifies that skill behaviour, or a new skill for a distinct workflow. Auto-memory is machine-local and will not reach another workstation. Keep it here only when it is specific to this project on this machine. State which you chose."}}';; esac
